policy_passages: A handler returns `None` or `True` to allow, `False` to deny with `403`, a dict to allow with filters applied to queries, or a modified `value`. "Handlers only restrict access when they explicitly deny."

There is no built-in owner field or role system. Isolation is built from handlers: write an owner or team marker into `value["metadata"]` on create, and filter on it for searches. A `threads` filter also applies to by-id reads and deletes, not only search.

There is no `runs` resource: run operations are authorized under their owning thread. `threads.create_run`: `POST /threads/{id}/runs`, `/runs/stream`, `/runs/wait`, commands, and stateless `POST /runs*`. Omitting `thread_id` does not bypass thread rules.
Not specified in the documentation: the status code returned when a caller reaches another user's resource.

section.title: API key deletion route and CRUD helper
section.rationale: Changes to the DELETE /api_key/{api_key_id} route, delete_api_key and its CLI caller.

lines: +from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Response
-async def delete_api_key(session: AsyncSession, api_key_id: UUID, user_id: UUID) -> None:
+async def delete_api_key(session: AsyncSession, api_key_id: UUID) -> None:

policy_passages: "A Langflow API key adopts the privileges of the user who created it." A key cannot reach resources outside its own Langflow server.
In multi-user mode, non-superusers cannot use their keys to reach other users' resources. `LANGFLOW_API_KEY_SOURCE=db` (default) validates keys per user in the database.
Revoking a key invalidates it immediately.
Not specified in the documentation: per-endpoint ownership rules beyond those listed above.

policy_passages: `proxy_admin`: "Admin over the entire platform": full control over organizations, teams, users, keys and budgets. `internal_user`: can log in, view/create/delete their own keys and view their own spend. Cannot add new users.
`team_admin`: manages their own team's members, member permissions and keys. Cannot create new teams, raise `max_budget` unless a proxy admin enabled it, or add or remove global proxy models.
A proxy admin, or an admin of the team or its organization, can reset a member's spend; a team admin cannot reset their own spend.

Not specified in the documentation: a per-endpoint role matrix for the `/user/*` and `/key/*` management routes; the role descriptions above are the documented rules.
